title: Echoes of Destiny
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji saw that future without Su Qingyao, his fingertips trembled slightly—the Scribe of Fate said this was the price he had chosen himself.

text.content: In the dark space, there was no distinction between heaven and earth, only countless threads of light woven into a web, each glowing with the unique pale blue hue of destiny. When Chen Ji set foot here, the Tianji Record Fragment automatically surfaced before his chest, humming unceasingly, as if warning its master of a forbidden existence ahead that even it could not fully decipher. There was no solid ground beneath his feet; every step landed on flowing fragments of time.

「You came.」The voice came from all directions, carrying an inexplicable sense of familiarity. Chen Ji looked up sharply to see the countless threads of light汇聚ing, condensing, solidifying at an alarming rate—finally forming a figure that made his pupils contract. The person looked exactly like him, only obviously older, with the sharpness and vicissitudes of years honed into his brow.

dialogue.content: 「Who are you?」Chen Ji suppressed the churning waves in his heart, his face remaining unruffled, his voice steady as if inquiring about the weather. However, the joints of his fingers gripping the Tianji Record Fragment had turned white, the sharp pain in his fingertips reminding him this was no illusion.

text.content: The person—if one could call it that—slowly curved his lips into an arc so familiar to Chen Ji. It was the smile he saw in the mirror: cold, calculating, with a touch of world-weary indifference. Threads of fate circulated around him, constantly weaving and unraveling, as if his very existence was engaged in some fierce game with the laws of destiny.

dialogue.content: 「Who am I?」Future Chen Ji laughed lightly, the sound echoing through the vast space of destiny with an indescribable irony, 「This question, you should know better than anyone. After all—」He stepped forward slowly, each step crushing the threads of fate beneath his feet, 「I was the one who led you here.」

text.content: The shock in Chen Ji's eyes finally surfaced, only to be forcibly suppressed the next moment. He took a deep breath, tucked the Tianji Record Fragment into his sleeve, and looked directly at this self that should not exist. 「So the Scribe of Fate... was never an independent entity. It is the echo of my future will.」

dialogue.content: 「Correct, plus points.」Future Chen Ji stopped, only three zhang from his past self, 「Every use of the Tianji Record Fragment consumes Heavenly Fate Value—you thought where did those消耗go? It became the bridge connecting past and future, allowing the present me to speak with you here.」

text.content: Chen Ji felt an unprecedented pressure emanating from across him. It was not spiritual pressure, not killing intent, but something more fundamental—a negation and correction from a future will. He suddenly understood, saying coldly: 「You want to change the past. You want me to abandon certain key choices.」

Upon hearing this, future Chen Ji's eyes flashed with appreciation, but it was quickly replaced by deeper coldness. He raised his hand, and a blurry scene materialized in the void—a possible future fragment where Chen Ji stood atop mountains of corpses and blood, solitary and powerful, with no familiar figure beside him.

dialogue.content: 「The price of this ending, is her.」Future Chen Ji pointed to the empty space in the scene, his voice terrifyingly calm, 「Su Qingyao will die at the final moment of your assault on the highest realm. And this line represents seventy-three percent of the development trend on the current timeline.」

choice.prompt: Faced with the brutal truth revealed by his future self, Chen Ji had to make a choice. The threads of fate intertwined before his eyes; every choice could lead to an entirely different future.

choices.description: Since the future can be changed, there must be other ending lines. Directly ask the future will: what price must be paid to save Su Qingyao?
choices.visible_cost: Expose your care for Su Qingyao
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key information about other ending lines
choices.risk_hint: The future will might use this to blackmail

text.content: Chen Ji's voice echoed through the space of destiny, carrying a tremor even he had not noticed: 「Since you can see this ending line, there must be other possibilities. Speak—what price must be paid to save her?」 The moment the words fell, he saw a complex light flash in his future self's eyes.

choices.description: Use the Tianji Record Fragment to shield your perception, forcibly severing the connection with the future will. Refuse any form of dialogue using Su Qingyao's survival as a bargaining chip.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the initiative in the game against the future will
choices.risk_hint: Forcible severance may cause Heavenly Fate Value backlash

text.content: Chen Ji raised his hand sharply, and the Tianji Record Fragment shot out from his sleeve, transforming into a golden light that enveloped him. 「I don't need to see.」 His voice was cold as frost, 「Whatever you show me, I will never use anyone's sacrifice as a bargaining chip. Not even my future self.」

choices.description: Calmly analyze the flaws in the other party's words. Is this a hallucination from Tianji Record backlash, or a new round of temptation from the Heavenly Dao? Demand proof that they truly are future Chen Ji.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key clues for distinguishing truth from falsehood
choices.risk_hint: If the other party is genuine, may damage the brotherhood relationship

text.content: Chen Ji stepped back, his eyes gleaming. He didn't respond to Su Qingyao's question, but instead coldly demanded: 「You say you're my future self—then tell me, in your time, what were the last three sentences Mo Xiansheng said to me?」 This was a secret known only between him and Mo Xiansheng.

dialogue.content: 「You've changed.」Future Chen Ji suddenly spoke these inexplicable words, his eyes carrying scrutiny, 「Or rather, you haven't become what I thought you would become.」He paused, his voice dropping, 「I thought you would毫不hesitatedly choose to change the past... but you're hesitating.」

text.content: Hearing this, Chen Ji felt somewhat reassured. He slowly lowered his guard, saying coldly: 「Hesitating? You're mistaken. I'm not hesitating about whether to save her—I'm thinking about whether the 'past me' you want me to change is truly me.」He stepped forward, eye to eye with the will of destiny, 「Or are you simply an existence that wants to devour me and take my place?」

choice.prompt: The will of destiny admitted it was not simply "Chen Ji," but a "Scribe of Fate" merging possibilities from multiple timelines. Chen Ji realized the true game had just begun.

choices.description: Since you are in me and I am in you, might as well go with the flow. Utilize your knowledge of future events to proactively weave new threads of destiny, tilting the scales of the game in your favor.
choices.visible_cost: May deepen the binding with the future will
choices.visible_reward: Gain partial control over the realm where destinies interweave
choices.risk_hint: Each interaction will accelerate Heavenly Fate Value consumption

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and made his decision. 「Fine, I cooperate.」 The moment the words fell, the surrounding threads of destiny shuddered violently, and countless pale blue lights surged toward his body. The Tianji Record Fragment trembled intensely, as if warning of something—but he still chose to accept this power.

choices.description: Regardless of what the other party is, such forcible intervention in the past is itself a violation of the law of causality. Using the Tianji Record Fragment as a blade, sever the thread of destiny connecting you to the future will, forcibly returning to reality.
choices.visible_cost: Massive consumption of Heavenly Fate Value
choices.visible_reward: Maintain independence, avoid being manipulated by the future will
choices.risk_hint: May suffer destiny backlash, causing foresight ability impairment

text.content: 「Cooperate?」Chen Ji sneered, and the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve appeared once more, golden light blazing. Using his finger as a sword, he drew a brilliant trajectory through the void—a slash that severed causality, 「The connection between us should not be determined by you. Get back to your timeline!」

The sword light fell, and the space of destiny violently trembled. The figure of the future will began to disintegrate, but before dissipating completely, he left one final words—the voice no longer carried playfulness, but a deep, almost pleading sigh: 「You will regret this... when you stand before her grave.」

Chen Ji jerked awake, finding himself still standing at the cliff edge of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. Cold sweat soaked his back, the night wind was biting, ruffling his robes. The Tianji Record Fragment lay quietly in his palm, as if nothing had happened. But in his heart, there was an eternally indelible shadow—the future without Su Qingyao was now clearly branded in his mind in an suffocating way.

He raised his head, looking toward the Tianqing Sect Main Peak in the distance. There, a lantern was still burning—that was Su Qingyao's residence. He didn't know what the price of that future truly meant, but he knew one thing: no matter how destiny weaves, he would never let that ending come true.

dialogue.content: 「Future me... you underestimated me.」Chen Ji tucked the Tianji Record Fragment back into his sleeve, a cold, sharp arc forming at the corner of his lips, 「You thought threatening me with her would make me comply? You're wrong—Chen Ji has been arranging the world, never to conform to destiny.」He turned toward the mountain path, his voice echoing in the night wind, 「But to rewrite it with my own hands.」

text.content: The moment he was about to step onto the mountain path, a figure darted from the shadows and landed steadily before him. Dressed in blue robes, with exquisite features, it was Su Qingyao. She held a Spiritual Energy Lamp in her hand, its flickering light revealing her slightly furrowed brow: 「Chen Ji, what are you doing here? Standing alone at the cliff edge in the deep night... are you waiting for something, or afraid of something?」

Chen Ji looked at the living, breathing Su Qingyao before him, and that "future without her" was like a thorn, deeply piercing his heart. He suddenly smiled, that smile unusually gentle: 「Senior Sister Su, going out at night violates sect rules.」He stepped forward, naturally taking the lamp from her hand, 「恰好, let me escort Senior Sister. The night mountain path is treacherous; if you fell, I couldn't bear the responsibility.」

Su Qingyao was startled by his sudden attentiveness, eyeing him suspiciously. This useless junior disciple always avoided her in the past—why the change today? But somehow, looking at the inexplicable, complex light in his eyes, she didn't refuse. The two walked side by side along the moonlit mountain path, the lamp's glow stretching their shadows long, overlapping like the initial entanglement of destiny.
